help: mirror this machine's own sessions of every served provider into that provider's store dir (what a machine pushes to the shared store)

args.name: --provider
args.help: every session of ONE served provider (the named totality of that provider's live store), or with --id one of them

args.name: --id
args.help: one session of the provider --provider names: a uuid prefix, eight characters or more, matching exactly one; requires --provider - a uuid's shape does not say whose it is, as the browser capture's --id says

args.name: --all
args.help: every session of every served provider (the whole outbox of each)

args.name: --to
args.help: capture to a scratch dir instead of the stores, each provider under <scratch-dir>/<provider>/ (test escape hatch — a directory, never a machine name)
